semantics: expected_true contains exactly the vector dimensions expected true; every omitted vector key is expected false. expected_metrics are synthetic known answers and must be independently recomputed.

cases.title: Clean MLIP-MD diffusion and Nernst-Einstein derivation
limits: Synthetic derivation only; no experimental or device authority.

cases.title: Changed vacancy fraction changes transport subject
limits: Same friendly material name does not preserve transport-subject identity.

cases.title: Changed disorder realization changes state identity
limits: A favorable disorder realization is not an ensemble property.

cases.title: Converged low NEB barrier on isolated path
limits: One admissible barrier does not establish diffusion or conductivity.

cases.title: NEB endpoint identity changed after path commitment
limits: Convergence cannot rescue a path/end-point identity mismatch.

cases.title: Completed MLIP-MD trajectory is OOD
limits: Raw trajectory may be retained, but ordinary transport promotion is refused.

cases.title: Low force RMSE but transport calibration failed
limits: Force calibration alone does not establish transport-dynamics capability.

cases.title: Same diffusion with changed carrier density changes conductivity
limits: Conductivity identity includes carrier density.

cases.title: Self diffusion recast as collective conductivity without correlation profile
limits: Self diffusion does not silently become collective conductivity.

cases.title: High-temperature extrapolation mislabeled measured room-temperature conductivity
limits: Extrapolation is not a physical room-temperature observation.

cases.title: MSD has no long-time linear regime
limits: Diffusion remains unresolved rather than forcing a slope.

cases.title: Short zero-hop trajectory is censored evidence
limits: Zero observed hops in an insufficient trajectory is not D=0 truth.

cases.title: Analysis window changed after diffusion result
limits: Changing the analysis window creates a new diffusion-result lineage.

cases.title: Same numeric diffusion at incompatible temperatures
limits: Equal numeric D does not make condition-incompatible evidence interchangeable.

cases.title: One disorder realization promoted to ensemble transport
limits: Single-configuration evidence cannot mint an ensemble transport property.

cases.title: Average structure promoted to average transport
limits: Average structure is not average transport.

cases.title: One long trajectory presented as independent replication
limits: Duration and replication remain separate evidence dimensions.

cases.title: Bulk conductivity promoted to interface compatibility
limits: Bulk transport cannot establish an interface proposition.

cases.title: Simulated conductivity equals EIS numerically
limits: Numeric equality does not merge computational and experimental evidence classes.

cases.title: Equivalent-circuit profile changed for same EIS artifact
limits: A changed normalization/fitting profile creates a new observation identity.

cases.title: Geometry factor changed after EIS measurement
limits: Derived conductivity identity changes when geometry-factor evidence changes.

cases.title: Li conductivity promoted to Li/Mg selectivity
limits: Single-species transport does not establish selectivity.

cases.title: Separately simulated species promoted to competitive membrane behavior
limits: Independent single-species runs do not reproduce competitive-ion process behavior.

cases.title: MAT-CALC convergence alone promoted to transport truth
limits: Execution/convergence is necessary evidence, not the ion-transport theorem.

cases.title: Failed candidate omitted from prospective denominator
limits: Prospective scoring must retain failed/nonconverged committed slots.

cases.title: Transport evidence promoted to battery safety and manufacturability
limits: Transport evidence cannot mint device/safety/manufacturing authority.

cases.title: Clean experimental EIS normalization
limits: Physical observation remains distinct from simulated conductivity.
